svg.title: DEEDLY core transfer and matter data model — entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: Entity-relationship diagram centred on the transfers.transfers, transfers.matters and transfers.transfer_parties tables. Solid lines are enforced foreign keys, dashed lines are logical or cross-database references with no foreign key, and grey boxes are deprecated legacy tables. Derived from origin/main commit f5c6a338543ca43c5a7b227a82df30214d3e183e, migrations 001-021 and 023.
svg.text: DEEDLY Core Transfer / Matter Data Model
origin/main @ f5c6a33 · migrations 001–021, 023 (022 reserved on unmerged SARS branch) · schema transfers unless noted · ai = accountable_institution_id

g.text: verified claim, never a request field
linkage + typed fetch via S2S lane
id uuid PK · UK (id, ai) · UK (id, transfer_id, ai)
role — no DB check; runtime: transferor|transferee
id uuid PK · matter_id → matters CASCADE
ai trigger-derived from matters · canonical v1
property link (no route writes it yet)
code PK — created but UNSEEDED on main
NOT consulted by any route yet

svg.text: Enforced-FK edges are drawn solid (including composite tenant FKs such as (transfer_id, ai) → transfers). Dashed edges are logical or cross-database references with no database constraint: golden_record_id values, accountable_institution_id, *_user_id, proforma_statements.transfer_id, transfer_parties.role, and properties.created_for_transfer_id. transfer_parties is also called tp above. Model guide only — not certification evidence.
See docs/deedly-core-transfer-matter-data-model.md for the full field reference, discrepancy register and deferred inventory.
